id.title: ID
id.description: The id of the new database.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human readable name of the database.

templateId.title: Template ID
templateId.description: The id of the template to use in creating the new database. The the two templates currently supported are "reporting" (Multi-partner reporting) and "casemanagement." If ommitted, a blank database with three simple roles will be added.

description.title: Description
description.description: An optional, longer description for the database.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email of the user to add

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the user to add. This is only used in the email invitation to the user if there is no existing ActivityInfo account with this email address.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The locale to use when sending an email invite to the user, expressed as the two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

role.title: Role
role.description: The role to assign to the user.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: Additional permissions to grant to the user.

resourceFilter.title: Resource Filter
resourceFilter.description: The id of a form, folder, or report. If provided, the result will only include events that relate to this resource.

typeFilter.title: Type Filter
typeFilter.description: Only include events of the given types.

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.description: The start time of the request, in milliseconds since the unix epoch. The results will include the first 100 - 150 events that occurred before this time.

endTime.title: End Time
endTime.description: The end time of the request, in milliseconds since the unix epoch. The results will include the events that occurred after the end time and before the start time.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The id of the requesting user. The contents of the tree depends on the permissions of the requesting user.

version.title: Version
version.description: The monotonically-increasing version of the database tree. The version number is incremented whenever a change is made that affects the database tree.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The list of languages that have been defined for this database, including the original language, if set, and any translations.

items.title: Language
items.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

suspended.title: Suspended
suspended.description: True if this database is suspended for billing reasons

role.title: Role
role.description: The requesting user's assigned role in this database.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: The roles that have been defined for this database.

publishedTemplate.title: Published Template
publishedTemplate.description: True if this database has been published as a template.

securityCategories.title: Security Categories
securityCategories.description: The security categories that have been defined for this database.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: The set of resources (folders, forms, and subforms) that belong to this database.

locks.title: Locks
locks.description: The record locks that have been defined on this database.

grants.title: Grants
grants.description: The direct (non-role) permission grants that have been made to the requesting user for this database.

billingPlan.title: Billing Plan
billingPlan.description: The billing plan name under which this database falls. The billing plan can have an affect on which features are avialable within this database.

startTime.title: Start Time
startTime.description: The start time of the request, in milliseconds since the unix epoch. The results will include the first 100 - 150 events that occurred before this time.

endTime.title: End Time
endTime.description: The end time of the request, in milliseconds since the unix epoch. The results will include the events that occurred after the end time and before the start time.

moreEvents.title: More Events
moreEvents.description: True if there are more events earlier than endTime available, but not included in this response. Submit a new request with a startTime equal to the endTime to fetch the next batch.

id.title: ID
id.description: An opaque, id uniquely identifying this event within this result set.

time.title: Time
time.description: The time of this event, in seconds since 1970-01-01.

user.title: User
user.description: The user who initiated this event.

recordRef.title: Record Ref
recordRef.description: The record ref, if this event concerns a record.

formId.title: Form ID
formId.description: The form id, if this event concerns a form.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version number of the affected resource.

databaseUserId.title: Database User ID
databaseUserId.description: For user permission events, this is the id of the user who was affected.

description.title: Description
description.description: A human-readable description of the event.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of event. Values: DATABASE_TREE, USER, RECORD, FORM, AUTOMATION

resourceTypes.title: Resource Types
resourceTypes.description: One or more type(s) of the resource(s) affected

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: Id of the affected resource OR id of the database if more than one resource type is present

added.title: Added
added.description: True if this event concerns an addition.

updated.title: Updated
updated.description: True if this event concerns an update.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: True if this event concerns an deletion.

recovered.title: Recovered
recovered.description: True if this event concerns a recovery of data.

reverted.title: Reverted
reverted.description: True if this event has been reverted by an administrator.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: The automation, if this event concerns an automation.

mergeId.title: Merge ID
mergeId.description: The merge id, if this event concerns a merge of records.

label.title: Label
label.description: A human-readable label for this automation

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: The resource (form, or subform) to which this automation applies.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: The trigger that applies to this automation. Values: RECORD_ADDED, RECORD_EDITED, RECORD_DELETED

triggerFormula.title: Trigger Formula
triggerFormula.description: The formula to which this automation applies. currently not supported

action.title: Action
action.description: The action to be performed by this automation

active.title: Active
active.description: Determines whether this automation is active or not

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL of the webhook action

DatabaseLock.title: DatabaseLock
DatabaseLock.description: A record lock that has been defined for a database

label.title: Label
label.description: A human-readable label for this lock

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: The resource (database, folder, form, or subform) to which this lock applies.

dateRange.title: Date Range
dateRange.description: The date range to which this lock applies, if it is a date-range lock.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: The formula to which this lock applies, if it is a rule-based lock.

message.title: Message
message.description: user description of the rule-based lock.

deactivated.title: Deactivated
deactivated.description: Whether or not this lock is active. True when deactivated

DatabaseLockDateRange.title: DatabaseLock
DatabaseLockDateRange.description: The start and end date for a date-range record lock on a database

DatabaseResource.title: DatabaseResource
DatabaseResource.description: A resource (folder, form or subform) that belongs to a database

id.title: ID
id.description: The resource's id. Form and subform resources must have globally-unique ids (across all of ActivityInfo) but folder ids are only guaranteed to be unique within a single database.

type.title: Type
type.description: The resource type. Values: DATABASE, FOLDER, REPORT, FORM, SUB_FORM

parentId.title: Parent ID
parentId.description: The id of this resource's parent, for example, a folder id. If this is a top-level folder or form, then the parentId will be the id of the database itself.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: The resource's visibility. Values: PUBLIC, PRIVATE, REFERENCE

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Permissions granted this role. Applicable for legacy roles, for grant based roles it will be limited to permissions that are NOT related to resources, like MANAGE_USERS, MANAGE_ROLES

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters defined for this role. Parameters can be referenced in filtering formulas.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Pre-defined filters. Role filters allow other users to choose filters for permissions without having to write formulas themselves. -- NOTEWORTHY - only used by legacy roles

DatabaseRoleParameter.title: DatabaseRoleParameter
DatabaseRoleParameter.description: Parameters defined for this role. Parameters can be referenced in filtering formulas.

parameterId.title: Parameter ID
parameterId.description: This parameter's string id by which it will be referred to in formulas.

range.title: Range
range.description: The id of the form resource from which the parameter's values are looked up.

DatabaseRoleFilter.title: DatabaseRoleFilter
DatabaseRoleFilter.description: Pre-defined filters. Role filters allow other users to choose filters for permissions without having to write formulas themselves. -- NOTEWORTHY - only used by legacy roles.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A formula that can be used to filter a record-level permission.

FieldCondition.title: FieldCondition
FieldCondition.description: A field-level condition associated with a Grant for a single database resource (database, folder, form, subform)

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: The field operations (view and/or edit) allowed for this condition

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Whether the condition requires all or any of the condition's rules to be met

FieldConditionRule.title: FieldConditionRule
FieldConditionRule.description: An individual rule for a field-level condition associated with a Grant for a database resource.

objectType.title: Object Type
objectType.description: The object type for this rule, e.g. 'FIELD'

predicateType.title: Predicate Type
predicateType.description: The predicate for this rule, e.g. 'IS' or 'ISNOT'

value.title: Value
value.description: The comparison value for this rule, e.g. the field id

visible.title: Visible
visible.description: True if the form is visible to the authenticated user

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: True if the form has been deleted

suspended.title: Suspended
suspended.description: True if the form belongs to a suspended database.

id.title: ID
id.description: The immutable CUID for this form. Must be globally unique within an ActivityInfo server

label.title: Label
label.description: A human-readable label for this form

schemaVersion.title: Schema Version
schemaVersion.description: A monotonically increasing version number of this schema assigned by the server upon updates

databaseId.title: Database ID
databaseId.description: The id of the database to which this form belongs

parentFormId.title: Parent Form ID
parentFormId.description: The id of this form's parent, if this form is a subform. Note that subforms can only be created by adding a subform field to the parent form.

elements.title: Elements
elements.description: This form's fields, section headers, and other elements.

id.title: ID
id.description: An immutable CUID for this field that is unique within the form

code.title: Code
code.description: A developer-friendly code for this field that can be used in formulas and in the API. Must match the pattern ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*

label.title: Label
label.description: A short human-friendly label for this field

description.title: Description
description.description: An optional more detailed sub-label for this field

relevanceCondition.title: Relevance Condition
relevanceCondition.description: A boolean-valued ActivityInfo formula that determines when this field is 'relevant'. Fields that are not relevant are not displayed during data entry and must be blank.

validationCondition.title: Validation Condition
validationCondition.description: A boolean-valued ActivityInfo formula that determines when this field's value is valid.

dataEntryVisible.title: Data Entry Visible
dataEntryVisible.description: If false, this field is not shown in data entry

tableVisible.title: Table Visible
tableVisible.description: If false, this field is not shown by default in the table view

required.title: Required
required.description: If true, a value for this field must be provided

key.title: Key
key.description: If true, this field is part of the form's natural key fields whose combination must be unique within the form

unique.title: Unique
unique.description: If true, the value for this field must be unique across the form's records

readOnly.title: Read Only
readOnly.description: If true, the value for this field cannot be modified by any user (but it can be set by default on record add).

defaultValue.title: Default Value
defaultValue.description: The default value for this field, set on record add

defaultValueFormula.title: Default Value Formula
defaultValueFormula.description: An ActivityInfo formula that generates the default value for this field, set on record add

typeParameters.title: Type Parameters
typeParameters.description: Additional type-specific properties of this field.

prefixFormula.title: Prefix Formula
prefixFormula.description: For fields of type 'serial', provides a formula that will be used to compute the prefix of the generated serial number.

digits.title: Digits
digits.description: For fields of type 'serial', indicates how many digits long the generated serial number will be

units.title: Units
units.description: For fields of type 'quantity', describes the units of the quantity

aggregation.title: Aggregation
aggregation.description: For fields of type 'quantity', describes the aggregation method e.g. 'sum'. Not currently used(?)

inputMask.title: Input Mask
inputMask.description: For fields of type 'FREE_TEXT' (user type 'Text' or 'Barcode'), provides a pattern-based input mask

barcode.title: Barcode
barcode.description: For fields of type 'FREE_TEXT' (user type 'Text' or 'Barcode'), true when field is barcode

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: For fields of type 'calculated', provides the formula for the field's value

cardinality.title: Cardinality
cardinality.description: For fields of type 'enumerated' (user type 'Single selection' or 'Multiple selection'), indicates whether single or multiple select

values.title: Values
values.description: For fields of type 'enumerated' (user type 'Single selection' or 'Multiple selection'), provided the list of valid choices

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.description: For fields of type 'enumerated' (user type 'Single selection' or 'Multiple selection'), indicate whether shown as dropdown or not. Only relevant for multiple selection, i.e. where cardinality: multiple

range.title: Range
range.description: For fields of type 'reference' or 'multiselectreference' (user type 'Reference', 'User', or 'Multiple Reference'), provides the id of the form that this field references. For 'User', this reference is '{dbid}@users'.

lookupConfigs.title: Lookup Configs
lookupConfigs.description: For fields of type 'reference', specifies the lookup configuration for the field.

formId.title: Form ID
formId.description: For fields of type 'subform' and 'reversereference', provides the id of the form/subform that this field references

fieldId.title: Field ID
fieldId.description: For fields of type 'reversereference', provides the id of the reference field on the form that this field references

captureMethods.title: Capture Methods
captureMethods.description: For fields of type 'attachment', indicates which types of attachments can be added.

requiredAccuracy.title: Required Accuracy
requiredAccuracy.description: For fields of type 'geopoint', indicates the accuracy required when automatically specifying location.

manualEntryAllowed.title: Manual Entry Allowed
manualEntryAllowed.description: For fields of type 'geopoint', true when manual entry of location is allowed.

indentationLevel.title: Indentation Level
indentationLevel.description: For fields of type 'section', indicates the level of indentation of the heading.

translationConfig.title: Translation Config
translationConfig.description: For fields of type 'FREE_TEXT', 'NARRATIVE' or 'calculated', the translation config specifies which other field this is a translation of, and into which language.

id.title: ID
id.description: The immutable CUID of this lookup item. Must match the format [a-z][a-z0-9]{0,25} and be unique within this field.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: An ActivityInfo formula specifying the field or expression being looked up.

lookupLabel.title: Lookup Label
lookupLabel.description: Human-readable label for this lookup item.

fieldId.title: Field ID
fieldId.description: The id of the field of which this field is a translation. Both fields must be of the same type.

items.title: Language
items.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

id.title: ID
id.description: The immutable CUID of this selection item. Must match the format [a-z][a-z0-9]{0,25} and be unique within this field.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for this selection item.

root.title: Root
root.description: The id of the requested form

databaseId.title: Database ID
databaseId.description: The globally-unique id of this database.

label.title: Label
label.description: The human-readable name of this database.

description.title: Description
description.description: A longer, optional description for this database.

ownerId.title: Owner ID
ownerId.description: The id of the user who owns this database.

billingAccountId.title: Billing Account ID
billingAccountId.description: The id of the billing account to which this database belongs

suspended.title: Suspended
suspended.description: True if this database belongs to a billing account that has been suspended.

publishedTemplate.title: Published Template
publishedTemplate.description: True if this database has been published as a template.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The list of languages that have been defined for this database, including the original language, if set, and any translations.

items.title: Language
items.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: A set of permissions for a single database resource (database, folder, form, subform) that is either associated with a role or given directly to a user.

resourceId.title: Resource ID
resourceId.description: the database, folder, form or subform being granted access to.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: An optional resource is granted selectively to individual users assigned to a role.

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: The set of operations (add/edit/delete etc.) and their record-level conditions permitted on this resource

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: The set of field-level conditions applied to this resource

uploadUrl.title: Upload URL
uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to upload staged import payload.

importId.title: Import ID
importId.description: Identifier used when starting an importRecords job.

type.title: Type
type.description: The type of the job to start.

descriptor.title: Descriptor
descriptor.description: The object containing the elements required for the specific type of job

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The id of the user who started the job

descriptor.title: Descriptor
descriptor.description: The job descriptor used to start this job

error.title: Error
error.description: If the job state is FAILED, the reason for the failure.

Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: An individual operation (add/edit/view) and any associated record-level condition, either associated with a Grant for a specific database resource, or assigned to a role directly for higher-level database operations.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: One of a number of predetermined values

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A formula which restricts a permission to specific records. Only record-level permissions can be filtered.

securityCategories.title: Security Categories
securityCategories.description: The security categories that have been defined for this permission.

id.title: ID
id.description: The id of the column. This is the column name used to identify the column in the resulting table.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: An ActivityInfo formula that calculates the value shown in the column. formula and expression are interchangeable, but formula is given precedence.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: An ActivityInfo formula that calculates the value shown in the column. formula and expression are interchangeable, but formula is given precedence.

formId.title: Form ID
formId.description: CUID of the root form to query. This is deprecated in favour of rowSources

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: The list of columns to retrieve

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: A boolean-valued ActivityInfo formula to filter the records included in this query. Resulting rows must match both the filter formula, if provided, and all the provided filterSets. Filter sets are more efficient than formulas when you have a large number of values.

filterSets.title: Filter Sets
filterSets.description: Set-based filters to apply to records returned by the query, each of which is a pair of a formula and a set of values to include. Resulting rows must match both the filter formula, if provided, and all the provided filterSets. Filter sets are more efficient than formulas when you have a large number of values.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort instructions specified with a formula and a direction. Only one sort instruction can be specified, so sorting on multiple columns must be done with a single formula expression.

formula.title: Formula
formula.description: The formula on which to sort.

rootFormId.title: Root Form ID
rootFormId.description: CUID of the root form to query.

fromImportContext.title: From Import Context
fromImportContext.description: True if update request comes from bulk importer

version.title: Version
version.description: The current version number of the dictionary. The version number is incremented each time the dictionary is updated.

language.title: Language
language.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

databaseId.title: Database ID
databaseId.description: The database to which this dictionary belongs

dictionaryId.title: Dictionary ID
dictionaryId.description: The dictionary id. This will either be "database" or "form/{formId}."

id.title: ID
id.description: The id of the string. This id is based on how the string is used in the database or form schema.

autoTranslated.title: Autotranslated
autoTranslated.description: True if this translation was made automatically.

resourceUpdates.title: Resource Updates
resourceUpdates.description: List of resources to add or update.

resourceDeletions.title: Resource Deletions
resourceDeletions.description: List of resource ids to delete from the database.

lockUpdates.title: Lock Updates
lockUpdates.description: List of locks to add or update

lockDeletions.title: Lock Deletions
lockDeletions.description: List of lock ids to delete

roleUpdates.title: Role Updates
roleUpdates.description: List of roles to add or update

roleDeletions.title: Role Deletions
roleDeletions.description: List of role ids to delete

languageUpdates.title: Language Updates
languageUpdates.description: List of languages to add or update

items.title: Language
items.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

items.title: Language
items.description: The two-letter ISO 639-1 code for the language, e.g. 'en' for English.

name.title: Name
name.description: The user's name, provided either when invited or by the user themselves after activating their account.

role.title: Role
role.description: This user's assigned role in the database.

version.title: Version
version.description: A monotonically-increasing version number. This version is incremented each time a change is made to the users permissions.

inviteDate.title: Invite Date
inviteDate.description: The date on which the user was invited to this database.

inviteAccepted.title: Invite Accepted
inviteAccepted.description: True if the user has accepted the invitation to create an ActivityInfo account.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: True if this user's account has been locked following too many failed authentication attempts.

userLicenseType.title: User License Type
userLicenseType.description: The type of user license required for this user, in this database.

lastLoginDate.title: Last Login Date
lastLoginDate.description: Date of last login on the platform.

id.title: ID
id.description: The id of the role assigned to this user.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: The user's values of the parameters defined for this role.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: The role's optional resources (database, folder, forms, or subforms) granted to this user.
